notes.title: Welcome to the Community Hub!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hi and welcome![/b][/p][p]We’re Lola & Anders – the two developers behind [i]Sound of Horses[/i].[/p][p]This is where we’ll share updates, behind-the-scenes peeks, and chat with all of you as the journey unfolds. Episode 1 is coming soon to Early Access, and we’re incredibly excited to finally open the doors and welcome you in.[/p][p]Feel free to ask questions, leave a comment, or just say hi!
Your thoughts mean a lot to us, and we’d love to have you along for the ride.[/p][p]– Lola & Anders[/p][p][/p]
